thread:
Alex: Hey team — alloc request 34567 is stuck in the routing queue, >2h. console shows PENDING_ROUTING. anyone seen this pattern recently?
Priya: Ugh — I saw a burst this morning. Can you paste the routing debug? `./ctl routing show 34567`
Alex: paste below:
```
Request 34567: state=PENDING_ROUTING
preferred_region=eu-west-1
allowed_pools=[reserved-us-west-2, spot-eu-west-1]
route_decision=null
last_error=NoCompatiblePoolFound
```
Priya: aha — preferred_region is eu-west-1 but allowed_pools doesn't include any reserved eu pools. looks like tag mismatch on the commit config.
infra-bot: [queue-monitor] WARNING: routing queue length=62, avg_wait=38m, backpressure=TRUE :warning:
Chris: Which scheduler evaluated this? Could be our new region-affinity change from last deploy. @Priya can you check the routing-policy DB?
Priya: checking DB... run: `SELECT * FROM routing_policies WHERE id='default'` -> returns region_affinity=[us-west-2] only. We accidentally promoted a US-first policy.
Marta: Oh no — we have 8 reserved commitments in eu-west-1, requests are being rejected and falling back to limited spots. Cost risk if we force cross-region. Opening a quick billing watch.
Marta: @billingbot can you create a watch on cross-region fallback charges for project:redwood-core for the next 48h?
billingbot: Created ticket BILL-9123: "Cross-region fallback cost watch (project:redwood-core)". Owner=finance-oncall.
Alex: short-term: can we manually whitelist reserved-eu pool for this request?
Chris: yes — I'll do a manual routing override for all stalled requests with tag eu-whitelist for 34567..34580. Doing now.
Chris: run: `./ctl routing override 34567 --pool reserved-eu-west-1 --reason "manual rescue"` -> response: OK.
infra-bot: [action] Manual override applied by Chris at 1977778000.
Priya: we should revert policy change in config repo and roll back the region-affinity change. I can open PR.
Marta: also please add a short note to the oncall runbook: if queued requests accumulate >30 and avg_wait>30m, check routing_policy region_affinity mismatch.
Alex: after override, allocation progressed to ALLOCATED, then PROVISIONING.
Alex: final status: allocation 34567 completed at 1977778277, host assigned gpu-node-eu-12.
Chris: created infra ticket INF-4519 to track root cause and add unit tests for region-affinity promotion.
Priya: PR opened: fix/default-region-affinity to include eu pools, link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/472
Marta: finance watching BILL-9123; early estimate of cross-region fallback cost < $150 for these manual overrides, but we should avoid repeated fallbacks.
Alex: thanks everyone. followups: INF-4519, PR 472, BILL-9123. I'll close this thread when we confirm no other stuck requests. :white_check_mark:
Priya: quick note — I also added a short query to the deploy pipeline to validate region_affinity contains at least one pool per active-region.
Chris: sweet. rolling back the bad deploy now.
Alex: resolved for now. will reopen if anything else pops up.
